desc.text:
<color=#ffd680>Normal Attack</color>
Deals 1 <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> .
During this match, after opposing characters have been affected by a total of 3 instances of Lunar Reactions, if there is a card with <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> attached to it in your Hand, place 1 random card in your Hand with <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> attached to it on top of your deck, then deal 1 <color=#99ff88>Dendro DMG</color> . (Once per Round)

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Skill</color>
Deals 1 <color=#80bfff>Hydro DMG</color> and creates <color=#ffffff>Gravity Ripple</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Gravity Ripple</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> Deal 1 <color=#80c0ff>Hydro DMG</color> .
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 2</color>

<color=#ffd680>Elemental Burst</color>
Deals 3 <color=#80bfff>Hydro DMG</color> and creates <color=#ffffff>Lunar Domain</color> .
<color=#ebe4d8>Lunar Domain</color>
<color=#ffd680>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Charged</color> : Also apply <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> to 3 random cards in the opponent's Hand, increase DMG dealt by your <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> by 2, and set the DMG dealt by your <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> to 3.
<color=#ffffff>When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Bloom</color> : Apply <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> to a random card in your Hand 3 times instead.
<color=#ffffff>When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Crystallize</color> : The number of <color=#ffffff>Moondrift Harmony</color> generated is changed to 3.
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 3</color>

desc.text:
<color=#ffd680>Passive Skill</color>
(Passive) During this match, when the opponent is affected by the <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged Reaction</color> / <color=#ffffff>Bloom Reaction</color> / <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystallize Reaction</color> , the reaction will be converted to the <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> / <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Bloom</color> / <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Crystallize</color> Reaction.
When the opponent is affected by the <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged</color> / <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Bloom</color> / <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Crystallize</color> Reaction: Deals 1 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> / <color=#99ff88>Dendro DMG</color> / <color=#ffe699>Geo DMG</color> . (Once per Round)

Applies Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Vaporize</color> : DMG +2 for this instance
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> <color=#ffffff>] Frozen</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives +2 Physical or Pyro DMG)
<color=#ffffff>[</color> <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffff>+</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffff>] Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that grants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged:</color> Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)

Applies Electro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Overloaded</color> : DMG +2 for this instance, the target is forcibly switched to the next character
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Superconduct</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro-Charged</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
[ <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> + <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> ] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Charged:</color> Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit. When created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.)

Applies Dendro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Bloom</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> ] that greants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Burning</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> ] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Quicken</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> ] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG
[ <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Lunar Bloom</color> : Deal +1 DMG for this instance, and apply [ <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> ] to a random card in your Hand

Reacts with Elements if they are already applied:
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#99ffff>Cryo</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Cryo Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#80c0ff>Hydro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Hydro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Pyro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)
[ <color=#ffe699>Geo</color> + <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> ] <color=#ffffff>Electro Crystallize</color> : DMG +1 for this instance, your active character gains 1 Shield point (Can stack, max 2 points)

<color=#ebe4d8>Cost Reduction</color>
Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)
<color=#ebe4d8>Usage(s)</color>
After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#ffffff>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.
This card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#ffffff>Usages</color> remaining.
<color=#ebe4d8>Lunar-Charged</color>
Creates a [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] that deals 2 <color=#ffacff>Electro DMG</color> at the end of the Round. (Usage: 1. Can stack, no stack limit.)
When the [ <color=#ffffff>Thundercloud</color> ] is created or when its usages increase, apply [ <color=#ffffff>Electric Shock</color> ] to a random card in your opponent's Hand.
<color=#ebe4d8>Lunar-Bloom</color>
Deal +1 DMG for this instance, and apply [ <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> ] to a random card in your Hand.
<color=#ebe4d8>Lunar-Crystallize</color>
This DMG +1, and create 1 <color=#ffffff>Moondrift Harmony</color> that can summon and enhance <color=#ffffff>Moondrift</color> and add it to your Hand.
<color=#ebe4d8>Electric Shock</color>
<color=#ffffff>End Phase:</color> If this card is in your hand, your character with the highest HP takes <color=#ffffff>Piercing DMG</color> equal to the number of stacks this card has. (Can stack, no stack limit)
<color=#ebe4d8>Moondrift Harmony</color>
Summons 1 <color=#ffffff>Moondrift</color> . If the <color=#ffffff>Moondrift</color> is already on your field, it gains1 to its number of effects.
